Thai Labor Law Chatbot

Skills & Technologies

Making Thai labor-law information easier to find and understand through a searchable library and natural-language questions.

Backend & APIs

Data & databases

Frontend

Tools & platforms

My contribution

I worked on the full-stack application, particularly backend APIs, legal-data processing, database integration, deployment, and automation for collecting legal information.

Technical decisions & outcome: Thai Labor Law Chatbot

Technical decisions

React provides the interface; FastAPI handles backend requests. PostgreSQL/Supabase stores legal and user data, with vector-based retrieval supplying relevant context to the Typhoon LLM. Python and regex prepare legal documents; Robot Framework automates collection from the Office of the Council of State website.

Outcome & learning

Our team built a working web application combining a labor-law information library with an AI chatbot. Users can search for information and ask questions in natural language.

Experience

Professional testing and data experience that informs how I approach software development.

Software Quality Assurance Engineer

SCB Techhub

Description

System and data validation based on predefined test cases, with a focus on repeatable testing workflows.

Key contributions

  • Developed Python scripts to compare datasets and validate results automatically.
  • Built Python/Qt GUI tools supporting validation through the Databricks UI, including repetitive file uploads and execution.
  • Used SQL/PySpark, Robot Framework, Selenium, and Playwright for data validation and testing.

Impact & learning

Reduced repetitive manual verification and made validation workflows more repeatable.
